name: paperfoot
description: Web search for AI agents: the search CLI skill and the metasearch.sh MCP server.

plugins.name: search-cli
plugins.description: Teaches Claude to use the search CLI: auto or explicit modes across a dozen search engines, page extraction, cost in every result. Needs the search binary (brew install paperfoot/tap/search-cli).

plugins.name: metasearch
plugins.description: The metasearch.sh MCP server: search and fetch tools over 13 engines, billed to your metasearch.sh balance. Needs a metasearch.sh API key.
